_what: World copy of recipes/rvt_blend_boulders.json for /Game/Alpine8K (carry 2026-10-04). The RVT assets are wired into the duplicated MASTER's RuntimeVirtualTextureSample nodes, so a world that samples its own RVTs needs its own master: the rig master reads RVT_LookDev_*, which have no volume in the world. Same source, blend_cm and strength as the rig; world Grass displacement is the same 0.03 m (recipes/alpine_8k.json material.displacement.per_layer), so the 25 cm band holds.
